# Flight capacity at a glance
**SAP S/4HANA 2023 · ADT for VS Code 1.2 · SQL Notebook**

Join, aggregate and explore SAP flight demo data directly in the editor.

SELECT FROM /dmo/flight AS f
  INNER JOIN /dmo/carrier AS c ON c~carrier_id = f~carrier_id
  FIELDS c~name AS Airline, COUNT( * ) AS Flights,
         SUM( f~seats_max ) AS Capacity,
         SUM( f~seats_occupied ) AS Booked,
         DIVISION( SUM( f~seats_occupied ) * 100,
                   SUM( f~seats_max ), 1 ) AS Occupancy_pct
  GROUP BY c~name
  ORDER BY Occupancy_pct DESCENDING

assertion.sql: SELECT COUNT( * ) AS N FROM /DMO/FLIGHT WHERE seats_occupied < 0
